documents.title: Intimation About Receipt Of Approval For Enhancement In Manufacturing Capacity Of Ethanol Plant
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Proceedings Of 43Rd Annual General Meeting Of The Company Held On 9Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial and operational performance for FY 2025-26, driven by growth in revenue, EBITDA, and net profit across segments including acrylic fibre, CPP film, and the newly commissioned ethanol plant. The company achieved operational efficiencies despite global geo-political tensions, foreign exchange fluctuations, and volatile input costs. Management highlighted stable demand in end-use sectors, ongoing efforts in energy conservation and R&D, and compliance with statutory and corporate governance standards. Pasupati Acrylon reported an increase in operational synergy and financial growth for FY 2024-25, with revenue from operations rising to Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh and profit after tax reaching Rs.

demand_outlook.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 5% CAGR till 2033.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based ethanol plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company received consents from respective authorities to enhance ethanol capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequently, the Company had filed an application with the concerned departments to enhance the capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day due to improve operational efficiency and the Company has received the consents from the respective departments/ authorities in this regard.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost was assessed at Rs. 167 Crore excluding working capital margin, and the company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost was assessed Rs. 167 Crore (excluding working capital margin) but the project was overrun due to Civil work. Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The company initiated steps to establish a grain-based ethanol project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the ethanol plant is Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Indian Bank sanctioned a term loan of Rs. 108 Crores for the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far on the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for the company's products are crude-derived and affected by fluctuations in crude prices.
margins_costs.quote: The raw material to produce the Company’s products is crude derived. The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in US/Israel-Iran War & Russia-Ukraine War.

margins_costs.claim: Fluctuations in the foreign exchange rate between USD and INR have a bearing on the company's margins due to import dependence.
margins_costs.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization measures through alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements, and operational efficiency led to significant savings.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue and net profit during the year declined due to lower demand and negative returns on the CPP segment.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The production capacity for acrylic products is 42,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: The production capacity for CPP film is 10,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: Acrylic fibre production and sales for the year were 35,212 MT and 37,878 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,212 MT and sale of 37,878 MT, as against production of 35,198 MT and sale of 33,850 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: CPP film production and sales for the year were 7,545 MT and 7,621 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 7,545 MT and 7,621 MT respectively as against production and sale of 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively during the previous year with an increase of 18.95% and 18.91% in production and sales respectively over the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Ethanol production and sales for the year were 41,923 KL and 41,162 KL respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 41,923 KL and 41,162 KL respectively as against production and sale of 790 KL and 440 KL respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT of Acrylic Fibre.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to explore possibilities of increasing exports and achieve better export performance in coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Algeria, Kenya, Peru, Ukraine, Morocco, Tunisia, Ethiopia, Nepal etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

management_commitments.claim: The performance of the CPP films division is expected to improve further in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: During the year, the performance was improved than the previous year due to better plant run rate, increased demand in the market and better sale realization and it is expected to improve more in the coming years.

management_commitments.claim: The company is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Peru, Thailand, Morrocco, Tunisia, Nepal, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Brazil, Poland, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.
